subject.title: feat: add metadata-only message audit events

question: Should OpenClaw core adopt this default-off message lifecycle audit contract and its shared-state persistence model?
rationale: The change adds privacy-sensitive persisted metadata, a new config option, a public gateway contract, and a global database migration; implementation quality cannot decide whether that permanent core product boundary is desired.

options.title: Approve the core audit scope
options.body: Adopt the proposed metadata-only lifecycle ledger after the real-behavior and upgrade evidence is attached.

options.title: Narrow the persisted contract
options.body: Reduce recorded fields, lifecycle coverage, or query/config surface before accepting message persistence in core.

options.title: Reject core message persistence
options.body: Retain run/tool auditing and rely on diagnostics or external observability for message lifecycle data.

recommendation.title: Approve the core audit scope
recommendation.body: Adopt the proposed metadata-only lifecycle ledger after the real-behavior and upgrade evidence is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior audit foundation and sustained history across the affected audit and delivery paths make this the strongest available product-direction owner.
